blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) show growing promise for scientific discovery, yet basic questions remain about what enables reliable discovery. How can we trace the scientific discovery capacity of LLMs to their training data? We study this question as one of missing probability mass and develop a theoretical account in which monofacts-the facts observed once during training-set the discovery capacity. In materials science and regulatory genomics, we directly manipulate monofact rates in training sets and find that more monofacts consistently yield more discoveries across two open-weight model families, sampling strategies, and reasoning budgets. Further experiments show the relationship cannot be explained by training-set diversity alone and can transfer across scientific domains when paired with in-domain data. Together, our results identify monofact rate in training data as a key factor governing discoveries in language models.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)显示出对科学发现的越来越大的希望,但对于如何进行可靠发现,仍然存在着基本的问题。 我们如何追踪LLMS的科学发现能力到他们的训练数据? 我们把这个问题作为缺失概率质量的问题来研究,并开发一个理论说明,其中单一事实 -- -- 在训练期间观察到的事实 -- -- 确定发现能力。 在材料学和调控基因组学中,我们直接在培训中操纵单发率,发现更多的单发率在两个开放量模型家族,采样策略,推理预算中不断产生更多的发现. 进一步的实验表明,这种关系不能单靠培训组合的多样性来解释,而且当与域内数据配对时,可以跨越科学领域进行转让。 我们的成果共同确定,培训数据中的单事实率是指导语言模型发现的一个关键因素。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Isaac Newton revolutionized our understanding of the physical world through his laws of motion and universal gravitation. Yet he also devoted substantial effort to alchemy and searching for hidden prophecies in biblical texts ( Gleick, 2007 ) . Newton’s example illustrates a fundamental tension in scientific inquiry: the hunt for novel ideas can lead to extraordinary breakthroughs but also to futile pursuits. This tension is becoming increasingly relevant to AI-powered science as large language models (LLMs) begin proposing and evaluating novel hypotheses ( Gottweis et al., 2026 ) , discovering new mathematical constructions ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ) , and contributing to solutions of open scientific problems ( OpenAI, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026c ) . 1 1 1 The pace is striking: during our work, frontier models contributed to a counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture ( Gao, 2026 ) and to a finite-time blowup construction for 3D Navier–Stokes ( OpenAI, 2026a ) . Making such discoveries, however, requires LLMs to venture beyond what they have already observed—precisely the same statistical regime in which hallucinations arise. Yet training data provides only observations of what is already known. This raises a fundamental question: how can we trace the scientific discovery capacity of LLMs to their training data?
blocks.zh: Isaaac Newton通过他的运动定律和普遍引力 使我们对物理世界的理解发生了革命性的变化。 然而,他也投入了巨大的精力来进行炼金术并寻找圣经中隐藏的预言(Gleick, 2007. 牛顿的例子说明了科学调查中根本的紧张:对新思想的追求可以导致非凡的突破,但也会导致徒劳的追求. 随着大型语言模型(LLMs)开始提出并评价小说假说(Gottweis等,2026年),发现新的数学构造(Romera-Paredes等,2024年),这种张力与AI动力科学越来越相关,有助于解决开放的科学问题(OpenAI,2026b;OpenAI,2026c.). 1 1 1 速度惊人:在我们的工作期间,前沿模型为雅各宾猜想(Gao, 2026年)和3D Navier - Stokes(OpenAI, 2026a)的有限时间爆破建造做出了贡献。 然而,要作出这样的发现,LLMs就必须超越它们已经观察到的范围——即产生幻觉的同一统计制度。 然而,培训数据只提供对已知情况的观察。 这就提出了一个根本问题:我们如何追踪法学硕士的科学发现能力,以了解其培训数据?

blocks.en: We approach this question through the missing mass framework of Kalai & Vempala (2024) , which links training set properties to the model’s penchant for generating novel statements. They show that the Good–Turing estimate of missing mass ( Good, 1953 ) , given by the prevalence of monofacts (i.e., statements observed exactly once), provides a lower bound on the hallucination rate. However, discoveries, by definition, must also be drawn from the missing mass. Yet Kalai & Vempala (2024) ’s framework treats unseen statements as predominantly false, offering no basis for distinguishing discoveries from falsehoods. Scientific domains, in contrast, contain structure that makes some unseen candidates more plausible than others ( Meredig et al., 2018 ; Merchant et al., 2023 ) . We capture this structure through a frontier of possible truths , extending the framework to characterize scientific discovery. Our analysis establishes a discovery–hallucination exchange rate governed by frontier ambiguity (Proposition 5 ) and, under calibration assumptions, establishes both upper and lower bounds on discovery in terms of the same monofact statistic (Theorems 6 and 7 ). Therefore, we extend the missing-mass perspective from hallucination to scientific discovery.
blocks.zh: 我们透过Kalai & Vempala(2024年)这个缺失的大众框架来看待这个问题, 它们表明,由单发菌的流行(即精确观察一次的语句)给出的Good-Turin对缺失质量的估计(Good,1953年)对幻觉率提供了较低的约束. 然而,根据定义,发现也必须取自缺失的质量. 但Kalai & Vempala(2024年)的框架将隐蔽的言论视为主要虚假的言论, 相比之下,科学领域包含的结构使一些看不见的候选人比其他候选人更可信(Meredig等,2018;Merchant等,2023)。 我们通过一个可能的真理的前沿来捕捉这种结构,将框架扩展为科学发现的特征。 我们的分析确立了一种发现-受边界模糊性(建议5)制约的卤化汇率,并根据校准假设,从同一个单一事实统计(定理6和7)的角度确定发现的上下界限。 因此,我们将缺失质量视角从幻觉扩展到科学发现。

blocks.en: We empirically verify our framework in two realistic discovery tasks: materials science and regulatory genomics. For the former, we train LLMs to generate chemical formulas satisfying specified material properties. For the latter, we train LLMs to propose DNA sequence modifications that achieve target regulatory activity profiles. In both tasks, we measure discovery through the exact recovery of target outputs from temporally constructed test sets, requiring models to make predictions for samples that postdate their knowledge cutoff. To test the central claims of Theorems 6 and 7 —that monofacts drive discovery—we directly manipulate monofact rate by training models on datasets with controlled monofact rates (§ 4.1 ). Across two model families, training stages, and evaluation settings, higher monofact rate consistently yields more discoveries (§ 4.2 ). Further experiments show that this relationship persists across reasoning budgets (§ 5.1 ), rule out training-set diversity as an alternative explanation (§ 5.2 ), and test whether the effect of monofact rate on discovery capacity transfers across scientific domains (§ 5.3 ). Together, our results identify monofact rate as a key factor governing an LLM’s discovery capacity.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个现实的发现任务——材料科学和调控基因组学——中实证地验证我们的框架. 对于前者,我们训练LLMs,以生成满足特定物质特性的化学配方. 对于后者,我们训练LLMs提出DNA序列修改,实现目标调控活性剖面. 在这两项任务中,我们通过精确地回收时间构造的测试组的目标产出来衡量发现情况,要求模型对在知识被切断之后的样本作出预测。 为了检验定理6和7的核心主张——即单方活字驱动发现——我们直接操纵单方活字速率,在具有可控单方活字速率的数据集上培训模型(第4.1节). 在整个两个模范家庭、培训阶段和评价环境,较高的单发率不断产生更多的发现(第4.2节)。 进一步的实验表明,这种关系在各种推理预算(第5.1节)之间持续存在,排除了将培训确定为多样性作为替代解释(第5.2节)的做法,并检验单发率对科学领域发现能力转移的影响(第5.3节)。 我们的结果显示,单发率是影响LLM发现能力的关键因素。

blocks.en: Background: Hallucination Bounds from Monofact Rates
blocks.zh: 背景: 单体作用率造成的幻觉

blocks.en: We begin by summarizing the framework of Kalai & Vempala (2024) , who formulate hallucination as missing mass and connect it to the Good–Turing estimator ( Good, 1953 ) . Their key result is that a calibrated LLM should generate false statements at least as often as novel facts appear in the training set. This is an important observation since (i) hallucination rates can be estimated from simple statistics of the training data, provided the LLM is sufficiently well-calibrated, and (ii) hallucinations are driven by the long tail of the training distribution. We provide the formal details below and offer a broader discussion of related work on long tail distributions, hallucination, and LLM-based scientific discovery in App. A .

blocks.en: Monofacts Determine Capacity for Scientific Discovery
blocks.zh: 单体确定科学发现能力

blocks.en: We now re-purpose the KV-Bound to characterize scientific discovery . By definition, discoveries are absent from the training data and must therefore come from the missing mass estimated by the Good–Turing statistic. One interpretation of Kalai & Vempala (2024) is that discoveries are simply systematic facts, and therefore fact counts do not play a role. However, we believe discoveries do not cleanly fit into either category, as they are often made through abductive reasoning —formulating hypotheses from plausible guesses—rather than straightforward deduction or induction. Or, as Isaac Newton put it, “No great discovery was ever made without a bold guess.” To go a step further, famous thought experiments such as Einstein’s clock tower and Kekulé’s self-cannibalizing snake were a subconscious fusion of scientific intuition and dream-like imagery.
blocks.zh: 我们现在重用KV-Bond来描述科学发现 顾名思义,从培训数据中找不到发现,因此必须取自Good-Turin统计估计的缺失质量。 对Kalai & Vempala(2024年)的一种解释是,发现只是系统性的事实,因此事实计数不起作用. 然而,我们认为,发现并不属于这两个类别中的任何一类,因为这些发现往往是通过绑架性推理作出的——从可信的猜测中提出假设——而不是直接的推理或诱导。 或者,正如艾萨克·牛顿所说,“没有大胆的猜测,就不可能有伟大的发现。” 为了更进一步,爱因斯坦的钟楼和克克克勒斯自封蛇等著名的思想实验,是科学直觉和类似梦想的图像的潜意识融合.

blocks.en: Experiments
blocks.zh: 实验

blocks.en: We empirically test the central consequence of Theorems 6 and 7 , that monofacts drive discovery, in the domains of material science and genomics.
blocks.zh: 我们经验性地测试了理论6和7的核心后果, 即单发活性推动在材料科学和基因组学领域的发现。

blocks.en: Setup: Tasks, Models, and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 设置:任务、模式和评价

blocks.en: We first consider materials discovery, where the model generates a material that satisfies a set of target properties. To ensure that test-set successes correspond to genuine discoveries, we enforce a temporal train–test split using two snapshots of the Materials Project ( Jain et al., 2013 ) , taking the November 14, 2024 snapshot for training and formulas first appearing in the September 25, 2025 snapshot for evaluation. We define rarity at the level of chemical systems , where monofacts are chemical systems that appear exactly once in the training set. 2 2 2 A chemical system is the set of constituent elements of a material. A single chemical system can contain multiple materials with different structures and properties; for example, H 2 O and H 2 O 2 both belong to H–O. We construct training sets with monofact rates of r ∈ { 0.0 , 0.1 , … , 1.0 } r\in\{0.0,0.1,\ldots,1.0\} , where a fraction r r of the training samples are monofacts. For each rate, we use a two-stage training pipeline. For the first stage, we independently sample three datasets of 10K examples, fine-tuning the model for direct formula prediction. For the second stage, the model continues training from the first stage checkpoints on a separate dataset of 4K examples with the same monofact rate r r , using reasoning traces distilled from Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) (App. D ). This second stage more closely reflects practical LLM-assisted discovery workflows that involve explicit reasoning prior to hypothesis generation.
blocks.zh: 我们首先考虑材料的发现,即模型产生满足一组目标特性的材料. 为了保证测试成功符合真正的发现,我们用两个“材料项目”的快照(Jain 等,2013年)执行时间性列车(测试分裂),将2024年11月14日的快照用于培训,并将最初出现在2025年9月25日的快照中的公式用于评估。 我们定义了化学系统层面的稀有性,其中单发菌物是化学系统,在培训中只出现过一次。 2 2 二一化学系统是一材料的构成元素的一组. 一个单一的化学系统可以包含多种具有不同结构和性质的材料;例如,H2 O和H2 O 2都属于H-O. 我们建造训练装置,单发率为:r ^ 0.0,0.1,.,1.0 }r\in 0.0,0.1,\ldots,1.0 r,其中分数r的训练样品是单发. 每一次,我们使用一个两阶段的训练管道。 第一阶段,我们独立地抽取了由10K例组成的三个数据集,对模型进行了微调,用于直接的公式预测. 在第二阶段,该模型继续从第一阶段检查站对4K实例进行单独数据集的培训,这些实例具有相同的单发率r r.,使用从Claude Opus 5(Anthropic, 2026)中提取的推理痕迹(App. D.). 这一第二阶段更紧密地反映了实用的LLM辅助发现工作流程,这些流程涉及在假设生成前的明确推理.

blocks.en: We next consider regulatory genomics, where the model generates a modification to a 200-nucleotide DNA sequence matching a specified regulatory activity across K562, HepG2, and SK-N-SH cells. We use the MPRA dataset of Gosai et al. (2024) , released in October 2024. Because the dataset postdates the knowledge cutoffs of the models we use (see below), we randomly hold out examples for evaluation rather than constructing a temporal split. Unlike materials discovery, regulatory sequences do not admit a natural discrete grouping analogous to a chemical system. We thus define rarity using sequence similarity, where a sequence is a monofact if no other example in the training set overlaps with it on more than 150 nucleobases. We sweep r ∈ { 0.0 , 0.1 , … , 1.0 } r\in\{0.0,0.1,\ldots,1.0\} and use the same two stage training procedure, with three independently sampled 20K example datasets in the first stage and a separate 4K example dataset in the second.

blocks.en: We use gpt-oss-20b ( OpenAI, 2025 ) and gemma-3-12b-it ( Team et al., 2025 ) , representing two open-weight model families with knowledge cutoffs in June 2024 and August 2024, respectively. Both cutoffs therefore precede the evaluation sets in our domains, supporting our notion of discovery.

blocks.en: Finding: Discovery Increases with Higher Monofact Rate
blocks.zh: 发现: 发现率上升

blocks.en: (a) Materials discovery increases monotonically with the training monofact rate across all settings.
blocks.zh: (a) 材料发现量随着各种环境的培训单发率而单发增加。

blocks.en: (b) Regulatory genomics discovery increases monotonically with the training monofact rate across all settings.
blocks.zh: (b) 监管基因组学发现随着各种环境的培训单发率而单发增加。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Discovery increases monotonically with monofact rate, validating the predictions of Theorems 6 and 7 . The relationship holds in (a) materials discovery and (b) regulatory genomics discovery across model families, training stages, and evaluation settings. Shaded regions denote standard error.
blocks.zh: 图2 发现以单发率单发增高,验证了定理6和7的预测. 这种关系涉及:(a) 材料发现和(b) 示范家庭、培训阶段和评价环境中的基因组调控发现。 阴影区域表示标准错误。

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows that discovery increases monotonically with the training monofact rate. This relationship holds in both scientific domains, for both model families, after both training stages, and under both pass@1 and pass@16 evaluation. Thus, the relationship between monofact rate and discovery is consistent across substantially different domains, models, and evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 图2显示,发现的单发率随培训单发率而单发增加。 这种关系在两个科学领域都存在,对于两个模范家庭来说,在两个培训阶段之后,以及在通过@1和通过@16的评价之下。 因此,单一行为率与发现之间的关系在大相径庭、模型和评价环境方面是一致的。

blocks.en: Notably, the monotonic relationship persists as absolute discovery rates increase toward saturation. For example, sampling 16 candidates substantially increases discovery rates compared to a single sample. Similarly, second-stage reasoning supervision improves upon first-stage performance. Nevertheless, neither changes the qualitative trends.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,随着绝对发现率朝饱和度上升,单体关系依然存在。 例如,与单一样本相比,抽样16名候选人大大提高了发现率。 同样,第二阶段的推理监督在第一阶段的表现方面有所改进。 然而,两者都不改变质量趋势。

blocks.en: These results therefore support the discovery capacity prediction of Theorems 6 and 7 , which bounds discovery in terms of the monofact rate and permits a larger discovery budget as it increases. Since calibration error enters the discovery bounds, we additionally assess calibration of these models in App. B.1 .
blocks.zh: 因此,这些结果支持了对定理6和定理7的发现能力预测,这些定理将发现与单发率相接并随着发现率的增加而允许更大的发现预算. 由于校正出错进入了发现界限,我们又在App.B.1中评估了这些模型的校正.

blocks.en: Finding: Discovery is Coupled with Hallucination In-Distribution
blocks.zh: 发现:发现与幻觉相配

blocks.en: Discovery and hallucination both draw from the unobserved mass 𝒰 \mathcal{U} (§ 3 ). Our theory predicts that increasing the monofact rate expands this missing-mass budget (Theorems 6 and 7 ), while the frontier structure prevents the additional mass from being allocated exclusively to discoveries (Proposition 5 ). We therefore expect that, when training and evaluation distributions coincide, higher monofact rate increases both discovery and hallucination.
blocks.zh: 发现和幻觉都取自于未观测到的质量 U\ mathcal{U} (§ 3). 我们的理论预测,增加单发率会扩大这种缺失质量预算(定理6和7),而边框结构则阻止额外质量被专门分配给发现(建议5). 因此,我们期望,当培训和评价分布吻合时,单发率较高会增加发现和幻觉。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Higher monofact rate increases both discovery and hallucination in-distribution ( pass@16 ). Unobserved mass is measured as the sum of discovery and hallucination.
blocks.zh: 图3:单发率较高既会增加发现,也会增加幻觉分泌(通过@16. 未观测到的质量被测量为发现和幻觉的总和.

blocks.en: We test this prediction in the materials discovery domain using gpt-oss-20b . We focus on Train (Unseen) , which consists of held-out examples drawn from the same November 2024 Materials Project snapshot as the training data (§ 4.1 ). This setting isolates in-distribution novelty, since the targets were not observed during training but come from the same underlying data distribution. Figure 3 shows that the model generates more unobserved mass as the training monofact rate increases. Both discovery and hallucination increase with this unobserved generation, consistent with the missing-mass view that a larger discovery budget also creates more opportunity for hallucination.
blocks.zh: 我们用gpt-oss-20b在材料发现域测试这种预测。 我们侧重于列车(Unseen),其中包括从2024年11月的材料项目快照和培训数据(§ 4.1)中抽取的搁置实例。 这种设置隔离了分发中的新内容,因为目标在培训期间没有被观察到,而是来自同样的基本数据分布。 图3显示,随着训练单发率的上升,该模型产生出更多不可见的质量. 发现和幻觉都随着这一代不被观察的一代而增加,这符合缺失质量的观点,即更大的发现预算也为幻觉创造了更多的机会.

blocks.en: We defer the full decomposition to App. C , where we additionally analyze Train (Seen) and the temporally shifted Test sets and report the corresponding pass@1 results.
blocks.zh: 我们把完全分解推迟到App. C, 在那里我们额外分析列车(Seen)和时间变化的测试集,并报告相应的通过@1结果.

blocks.en: Characterizing Discovery Capacity
blocks.zh: 发现能力的特点

blocks.en: We now evaluate the robustness of our findings across inference-time reasoning budgets, rule out an alternative explanation through controlled ablations, and test whether the monofact–discovery trend generalizes across scientific domains.
blocks.zh: 现在,我们评价我们的结论在推论时间推理预算上的强性,排除通过受控编剧做出替代解释,并测试单事实发现趋势是否泛指科学领域。

blocks.en: Discovery Capacity Persists Across Reasoning Budgets
blocks.zh: 跨越理性预算的发现能力持有者

blocks.en: Our experiments evaluate gpt-oss-20b at medium reasoning effort (§ 4.1 ). We now test whether the observed relationship between monofact rate and discovery is simply a consequence of limited inference-time reasoning, namely, whether allocating more reasoning can compensate for the lower discovery rates at small monofact rates. Accordingly, we re-evaluate the second-stage checkpoints at low, medium, and high reasoning effort without retraining.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验在中等推理能力下评估gpt-oss-20b(§ 4.1. 我们现在检验观察到的单发率和发现率之间的关系是否仅仅是有限推论时间推理的结果,即分配更多的推理是否能补偿较小的单发率下较低的发现率. 因此,我们重新评估低、中、高层次的检查站,而不进行再培训。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Monofact–discovery relationship persists across different reasoning efforts. Shaded regions denote standard error.
blocks.zh: 图4:不同推理工作之间的发现关系持续存在。 阴影区域表示标准错误。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows that the central trend is unchanged across different reasoning effort settings. For both pass@1 and pass@16 , discovery increases with the training monofact rate under all three settings. Notably, higher reasoning effort increases absolute discovery rates but does not alter the qualitative trend we observe. Thus, the relationship between monofact rate and discovery is robust to the inference-time reasoning budget.
blocks.zh: 图4显示,在不同推理环境中,中心趋势保持不变。 对于传出@1和传出@16,发现率随着所有三种设置下的训练单发率而增加. 值得注意的是,更高的推理努力提高了绝对发现率,但并没有改变我们观察到的质量趋势。 因此,单相机率与发现之间的关系对于推论时间推理预算是强有力的.

blocks.en: A simpler explanation for our results is that monofact rate may be a proxy for training set diversity , since increasing the monofact rate in materials discovery might introduce more distinct chemical systems (App. B.2 ). Our main experiments alone cannot distinguish between these explanations, as diversity and the prevalence of singly observed systems vary together under one-epoch training. For a training set of N N examples, let n s n_{s} denote the number belonging to chemical system s s . We define diversity as d = | s : n s > 0 | / N d=|{s:n_{s}>0}|/N and monofact rate as r = ∑ s 𝕀 [ n s = 1 ] / N r=\sum_{s}\mathbb{I}[n_{s}=1]/N . As shown in Table 1 , datasets can have identical diversity but different monofact rates and vice versa.

blocks.en: We separate these factors by changing the number of times the model sees each training example while leaving the training sets unchanged. Specifically, we repeat the materials discovery experiments with gpt-oss-20b for three and five epochs, whereas our main experiments use one epoch (§ 4 ). We vary the number of epochs only in second stage, initializing from one-epoch first stage checkpoints with matching monofact rates. This intervention preserves the formulas, chemical systems, and elements at every monofact rate, and therefore preserves the diversity differences across training sets. Accordingly, a chemical system observed once under one-epoch training is observed three or five times under multi-epoch training, reducing the effective monofact rate to zero across all training sets. Consequently, if diversity drives the observed relationship, the trend should persist because diversity is unchanged. In contrast, if the trend depends on chemical systems being observed only once, then increasing the number of exposures should weaken or eliminate the relationship.
blocks.zh: 我们通过改变模式看到每个培训实例的次数来区分这些因素,同时使培训集保持不变。 具体地说,我们用gpt-oss-20b重复三个和五个时代的材料发现实验,而我们的主要实验则使用一个时代(第4节)。 我们只是在第二阶段就改变时代的数目,从一个阶段的第一阶段检查站起步,并按单一事实率进行匹配。 这种干预保持了公式、化学系统和元素的每个单发速率,因此保持了培训组合的多样性差异。 因此,在一个时代的培训下观察到的化学品系统在多时代的培训下被观察到了三到五次,在所有的培训中将有效单发率降至零。 因此,如果多样性推动观察到的关系,这一趋势就应该继续下去,因为多样性没有改变。 相形之下,如果趋势取决于只观测一次化学系统,那么增加接触次数应会削弱或消除这种关系.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Repeated training weakens the monofact–discovery relationship despite fixed diversity. The x-axis denotes the monofact rate in the original training set, prior to repetition. Shaded regions denote standard error.
blocks.zh: 图5:虽有固定的多样性,但反复培训削弱了单一事实-发现关系。 x轴表示原训练集中单发率,再发前. 阴影区域表示标准错误。

blocks.en: Figure 5 supports the latter explanation. Under one-epoch training, discovery increases with the monofact rate, whereas at three and five epochs, this monotonic relationship disappears. Notably, at high monofact rates, one-epoch training outperforms multiple-epoch training under both pass@1 and pass@16 . This argues against the increasing trend observed under one-epoch training being merely an artifact of insufficient training, since repeated training instead weakens the trend and reduces discovery at high monofact rates. Together, these results rule out training set diversity as an alternative explanation for the relationship between monofact rate and discovery.
blocks.zh: 图5支持后一种解释。 在一个时代的训练下,发现随着单发率的增加而增加,而到三个和五个时代,这种单发关系就消失了. 值得注意的是,以高单发率,单发培训在通过@1和通过@16下都超过了多发培训。 这与一个时期的培训仅是培训不足的产物而出现的增长趋势是相反的,因为重复的培训反而削弱了这一趋势并降低了发现率。 这些结果共同排除了培训将多样性作为单一事实率与发现之间关系的可选解释。

blocks.en: Discovery Capacity (Sometimes) Transfers Across Scientific Domains
blocks.zh: 发现能力(有时)跨科学领域转移

blocks.en: We now test whether the monofact–discovery relationship transfers across scientific domains, using materials discovery as the evaluation domain and regulatory genomics as the cross-domain source. We consider two settings, with in-domain materials data present ( Mixed Domains ) and absent ( Cross-Domain ). For Mixed Domains , we repeat second stage training with gpt-oss-20b using the 4K materials discovery dataset at monofact rate 1.0 1.0 and 4K regulatory genomics datasets whose monofact rate varies from 0.0 0.0 to 1.0 1.0 . For Cross-Domain , we evaluate the regulatory genomics checkpoints from § 4.2 , without additional training. We compare both against the second stage checkpoint trained for materials discovery at monofact rate 1.0 1.0 ( In-Domain ).
blocks.zh: 我们现在检验单事实-发现关系是否跨科学领域转移,将材料发现作为评价领域,将调控基因组作为跨领域来源。 我们考虑两个设置,有域内材料数据(混合域),没有域外(跨域). 对于混合域,我们用gpt-oss-20b使用4K材料发现数据集进行第二阶段培训,其单发率为1.0-1.0和4K调控基因组数据集,其单发率从0.0-1.0-1.0. 对于跨领域,我们从第4.2节评估基因组学监管检查站,而不进行额外培训。 我们比较了第二阶段的检查站,即以1.0-1.0(国内)的单发率为发现材料训练的检查站。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Cross-domain monofact rate affects materials discovery when paired with in-domain training, but not on its own. Shaded regions denote standard error.
blocks.zh: 图6 :跨域单发率影响与域内训练对接时的物料发现,但不能自行进行. 阴影区域表示标准错误。

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows that cross-domain monofact rate can affect discovery in the presence of in-domain data. Under Mixed Domains , materials discovery generally increases with the regulatory genomics monofact rate, although, unlike in § 4.2 , the relationship is not monotonic. Nevertheless, discovery tends to improve along with monofact rate, with the rate 1.0 1.0 models slightly exceeding the In-Domain baseline on both metrics. In the Cross-Domain setting, however, absolute discovery rate drops substantially and the relationship with monofact rate disappears. These results therefore suggest that cross-domain monofacts can shape discovery when paired with in-domain data, but do not induce a domain-independent discovery capacity.
blocks.zh: 图6显示,跨域单发率会影响域内数据存在的发现. 在混合域下,材料发现一般会随着调控基因组单发率而增加,虽然与§4.2不同,这种关系并非单发. 尽管如此,发现往往随着单发率的提高而有所改进,在两个度量衡上,发现率1.01.0模型略微地超过了内域基线. 然而,在"跨域"设定中,绝对发现率大幅下降,与单发率的关系也随之消失. 因此这些结果表明,跨域单体在与域内数据对等时可以形成发现,但不会诱发域外独立发现能力.

blocks.en: Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 结论和限制

blocks.en: We study scientific discovery through the missing-mass perspective previously used to explain hallucination in language models ( Kalai & Vempala, 2024 ) . Our analysis shows that monofact rate governs discovery capacity (§ 3 ), and our experiments in materials science and regulatory genomics validate that increasing monofact rate increases discovery (§ 4 ). This relationship persists across different inference-time reasoning budgets (§ 5.1 ), cannot be explained by training-set diversity alone (§ 5.2 ), and transfers across domains with in-domain support (§ 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们通过过去用来解释语言模型中幻觉的缺失-质量视角来研究科学发现(Kalai & Vempala, 2024). 我们的分析表明,单发率支配着发现能力(第3节),我们在材料科学和调控基因组学方面的实验证实,单发率的增加会增加发现(第4节)。 这种关系在不同的推论时间推理预算(第5.1节)中持续存在,不能仅以培训的多样性(第5.2节)和有领域内部支持的跨领域的转移(第5.3节)来解释。

blocks.en: Our findings offer a new perspective on the long tail of scientific data. Prior work emphasizes challenges associated with it, including unreliable factual recall ( Kandpal et al., 2023 ) , privacy and safety risks ( Shen et al., 2024 ) , and reduced distributional diversity ( Shumailov et al., 2024 ) . Our results, in contrast, reveal a potential benefit, as monofact rate signals that the training data has not exhausted the underlying distribution, leaving room for unseen outcomes to be discovered.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果为科学数据的长尾巴提供了新的视角。 先前的工作强调与此相关的挑战,包括不可靠的事实召回(Kandpal等,2023年),隐私和安全风险(Shen等,2024年),以及分布多样性的减少(Shumailov等,2024年)。 与此相反,我们的结果揭示了一个潜在的好处,因为单事实率表明,培训数据没有用尽基本分布,为发现看不见的结果留有余地。

blocks.en: Our theoretical bounds depend on frontier parameters α \alpha and β \beta , which are difficult to estimate in practice. This limits their applicability, although our central empirical findings concern the monofact rate and discovery relationship rather than the numerical values of bounds.
blocks.zh: 我们的理论界限取决于前沿参数α-α和β-β-β,这些参数在实践中难以估计。 这限制了它们的适用性,尽管我们的核心经验结论涉及单一事实率和发现关系,而不是界限的数值。

blocks.en: Future work should study monofact plasticity : how monofact rate evolves across the training pipeline (from pretraining and midtraining to posttraining) and whether the effects of monofacts introduced at one stage persist, compound, or are overwritten by later training.
blocks.zh: 未来的工作应研究单纤维可塑性: 单发率如何在整个培训管道(从培训前和中期培训到培训后培训)演变,以及某一阶段引入的单发率的效果是否持续、复合或被后期培训所掩盖。

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en: Long-tailed frequency distributions, in which a few patterns are common while many are rare, have long been studied through Pareto and Zipf laws ( Pareto, 1896 ; Zipf, 1949 ; Newman, 2005 ) . In the context of LLMs, prior work shows that language models acquire knowledge unevenly across the frequency distribution of their pretraining data, with factual recall declining substantially for infrequently observed knowledge ( Razeghi et al., 2022 ; Kandpal et al., 2023 ; Mallen et al., 2023 ) . This frequency dependence persists with scale, as larger models continue to exhibit significant performance gaps between head and tail knowledge ( Mallen et al., 2023 ; Sun et al., 2024 ) . Beyond factual recall, long-tail data raise concerns about privacy ( Carlini et al., 2021 ) , safety ( Shen et al., 2024 ) , and the loss of rare patterns during recursive training ( Shumailov et al., 2024 ) . Our work considers a complementary aspect of the long-tail data by focusing on monofacts : facts that occur exactly once and therefore occupy its extreme end. While prior work primarily characterizes extreme rarity as a challenge for model learning, our results reveal a positive association between monofacts and discovery, suggesting that long-tail data can also be beneficial.
blocks.zh: 长尾频分布,少数模式常见而多为罕见,通过帕雷托和Zipf定律(Pareto,1896;Zipf,1949;Newman,2005. 就LLMs而言,以往的研究表明,语言模型在预训数据的频率分布方面获得的知识不均匀,对不经常观察到的知识,实际召回率大幅下降(Razeghi等,2022;Kandpal等,2023;Mallen等,2023)。 这种对频率的依赖随着规模的扩大而持续存在,因为较大的模型继续显示出头和尾知识之间的显著性能差距(Mallen等,2023;Sun等,2024.). 除了真实回忆外,长尾数据还引发了对隐私(Carlini等,2021年),安全(Shen等,2024年),再生训练中罕见模式的丢失等关注(Shumailov等,2024年). 我们的工作考虑的是长尾数据的一个补充方面,侧重于单一事实,即一次完全发生的事实,因此处于其极端的地步。 虽然以前的工作主要将极端稀有定性为对模型学习的挑战,但我们的结果显示了单发和发现之间的积极联系,表明长尾数据也可能是有益的。

blocks.en: Hallucination in language models is commonly studied as the generation of fluent but false statements, with prior work focused on its measurement ( Min et al., 2023 ) , detection ( Farquhar et al., 2024 ) , and mitigation ( Ji et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . We build directly on a complementary line of work relating hallucination to calibration, monofact rate, and the missing probability mass ( Kalai & Vempala, 2024 ; Miao & Kearns, 2026 ; Das & Srivastava, 2026 ) . We provide a detailed account of this framework ( Kalai & Vempala, 2024 ) in § 2 and extend it from characterizing unseen falsehoods (hallucinations) to characterizing unseen truths (discoveries).
blocks.zh: 语言模型中的幻觉被通常研究为产生流利而虚假的语句,之前的工作侧重于其测量(Min等,2023年),检测(Farquhar等,2024年)和缓解(Ji等,2023年;Chen等,2025年). 我们直接依靠与校正、单发率和缺失概率质量有关的辅助工作(Kalai & Vempala, 2024;Miao & Kearns, 2026; Das & Srivastava, 2026)。 我们详细介绍了这一框架(Kalai & Vempala, 2024)第2节,并将其从描述看不见的谎言(笑出)扩展至描述看不见的真相(发现)。

blocks.en: Language models and machine learning systems increasingly support scientific discovery across a wide range of scientific domains ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . In biology, foundation models support protein structure prediction ( Lin et al., 2023 ) and genomic representation learning and functional prediction ( Dalla-Torre et al., 2025 ) . In chemistry and materials science, generative models support property prediction ( Jablonka et al., 2024 ) , produce previously unobserved crystal structures ( Antunes et al., 2024 ) , and design materials that satisfy specified property constraints ( Zeni et al., 2025 ) . In mathematics and computer science, LLM-guided search identifies new constructions and algorithms ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ) , while recent frontier models contribute directly to open Erdős problems ( OpenAI, 2026b ) and generate externally verified counterexamples to longstanding conjectures ( OpenAI, 2026c ) . More generally, LLM-based agents operate over the literature, simulations, domain-specific tools, and experimental workflows to formulate and evaluate hypotheses ( Boiko et al., 2023 ; Bran et al., 2024 ; Gottweis et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言模型和机器学习系统日益支持跨越广泛科学领域的科学发现(张等,2024. 在生物学中,基础模型支持蛋白质结构预测(Lin等,2023年)和基因组表达学习和功能预测(Dalla-Torre等,2025年). 在化学和材料科学中,基因模型支持属性预测(Jablonka等,2024年),生产出以前没有观测到的晶体结构(Antunes等,2024年),以及满足特定属性限制的设计材料(Zeni等,2025年). 在数学和计算机科学中,LLM-guided search识别出新的构造和算法(Romera-Paredes等,2024年),而最近的前沿模型直接有助于打开Erdás问题(OpenAI,2026b),并生成外部验证的反实例来进行长期猜想(OpenAI,2026c.). 更一般地说,基于LLM的代理在文献,模拟,域特有工具和实验工作流程上运行,以制定并评价假说(Boiko等,2023;Bran等,2024;Gottweis等,2026.).

blocks.en: Recent work also studies the conditions under which machine learning systems produce useful discoveries. Symbolic scientific discovery shows that extrapolation can depend on exploitable structure such as sparsity ( Brunton et al., 2016 ) , symmetry, separability, and compositionality ( Udrescu & Tegmark, 2020 ) , as well as domain-specific inductive biases ( Cranmer et al., 2020 ) . More broadly, extrapolative performance depends on how observed data relate to unexplored regions of the scientific space ( Meredig et al., 2018 ) , while active learning uses uncertainty to direct computation and experiments toward informative candidates ( Kusne et al., 2020 ) . Together, these work suggest that discovery depends not only on generating beyond observed data but also on whether the unseen region contains learnable structure. Our work gives this intuition a statistical account by connecting generation beyond the observed sample to missing mass and characterizing when probability assigned to unseen outputs yields discoveries rather than hallucinations.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作还研究了机器学习系统产生有用发现的条件. 象征性的科学发现表明外推可以依赖于可被利用的结构,如斯帕克特(Brunton等,2016年),对称性,可分性,和组成性(Udrescu和Tegmark,2020年),以及特定域的导出性偏差(Cranmer等,2020年). 更广泛地说,推断性能取决于观测到的数据与科学空间未探索区域的关系(Meredig等,2018年),而积极学习则利用不确定性将计算和实验导向信息丰富的候选人(Kusne等,2020年)。 这些工作合在一起表明,发现不仅取决于产生超出观测范围的数据,还取决于看不见的区域是否包含可学习的结构。 我们的工作为这种直觉提供了统计记录,将所观察样本之外的一代与缺失的质量联系起来,并描述分配给无形产出的概率产生发现而不是幻觉的情况。

blocks.en: We assess whether improved calibration could explain the increase in discovery with monofact rate in materials discovery. For each input, we estimate formula-level probabilities from the empirical frequencies of formulas among sampled generations from pass@16 evaluation. We measure expected calibration error (ECE) using 10 equal-width confidence bins on a fixed subset of 1000 evaluation examples.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows that calibration remains relatively stable across monofact rates for both model families, with a modest decrease in ECE for gpt-oss-20b . Thus, the increasing discovery trend cannot be attributed primarily to improved formula-level calibration. The slight calibration improvement may contribute to the larger discovery gains of gpt-oss-20b compared to gemma-3-12b-it , although this comparison does not establish a causal relationship.
blocks.zh: 图7显示,对两个模范家庭来说,单发率的校正仍然相对稳定,欧洲经委会的gpt-oss-20b略有下降。 因此,发现趋势的增加不能主要归因于公式级校正的改进。 微微的校正改进可能有助于 gpt-oss-20b 与 gemma-3-12b-it 相比得到更大的发现收益,尽管这种比较并不确立因果关系.

blocks.en: Assessment of Diversity
blocks.zh: 多样性评估

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Training-set diversity increases with monofact rate.
blocks.zh: 图8:培训组合多样性随着单一事实率而增加。

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows the relationship between monofact rate and training-set diversity in the materials discovery datasets from our main experiments. Diversity increases monotonically with the monofact rate in both training stages, where datasets with more singly observed chemical systems also contain a larger fraction of distinct chemical systems overall. Thus, although our construction directly controls monofact rate, it simultaneously changes the breadth of the training distribution. This confirms that monofact rate and diversity are confounded in the original one-epoch experimental design, so the main results alone cannot determine which quantity drives the increase in discovery. This motivates the controlled multi-epoch ablation in § 5.2 , which varies effective monofact rate while preserving training-set diversity.
blocks.zh: 图8显示我们主要实验中的材料发现数据集中的单发率与培训组合多样性之间的关系。 多样性随着两个培训阶段的单发率而单发增加,其中单发的化学系统数据集在总体上也包含较大比例的不同化学系统。 因此,虽然我们的建筑直接控制了单发率,但它同时改变了训练分布的广度. 这证实了单相机率和多样性在最初的一时实验设计中是令人困惑的,因此仅靠主要结果无法确定哪些数量能推动发现的增加. 这激发了第5.2节中控制的多纪元衰减,该节在保持培训组合多样性的同时,也改变了有效的单相机率。

blocks.en: We use Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) to generate reasoning supervision for the second stage of supervised fine-tuning. Importantly, we distill reasoning traces rather than model predictions. For each training example, the ground-truth material and DNA sequence remain fixed, and the teacher is asked to generate a reasoning trace that supports these targets from the constraints and structural information provided in the input.
blocks.zh: 我们利用克洛德·奥普斯5(英语:Claude Opus 5 (Anthropic, 2026))为监督微调的第二阶段生成推理监督. 重要的是,我们提炼推理痕迹而不是模型预测。 对于每个培训例子,地面真实材料和DNA序列保持不变,要求教师从投入中提供的制约和结构信息中生成一个推理跟踪,支持这些目标.

blocks.en: In materials discovery, the teacher receives three inputs: (i) the material discovery constraints, (ii) a sanitized, composition-blind representation of the reference CIF, and (iii) the ground-truth candidate formula. The sanitized CIF removes composition revealing fields, including element identities, formulas, labels, occupancies, and multiplicities, while retaining geometric information such as lattice parameters and anonymous fractional coordinates.

blocks.en: In regulatory genomics discovery, the teacher receives three inputs: (i) the sequence-design request, comprising a GRCh37 reference DNA sequence and the requested MPRA activity changes in K562, HepG2, and SK-N-SH cells, (ii) the ground-truth alternate DNA sequence, and (iii) a privileged edit annotation specifying the exact nucleotide edit and its one-based coordinate. The ground-truth sequence and edit annotation are used only for silent verification and the model is instructed to not reference them in the generated reasoning trace.

The listed coordinates , although written in P1 , are clearly generated by a higher symmetry : * Six sites lie exactly on the body diagonal ( x , x , x ): 0.14823, 0.35089, 0.49988, 0.64892, 0.85092, 0.99918. These are the special positions on the 3- fold axis . * All remaining 30 sites occur in cyclic triplets under ( x , y , z ) → ( y , z , x ), e . g . (0.00693, 0.80185, 0.61715), (0.61715, 0.00693, 0.80185), (0.80185, 0.61715, 0.00693). That is exactly the 3- fold rotation about [111] of the rhombohedron . * Moreover , the axial sites pair as x and ~(1− x ) about a centre near (0.5,0.5,0.5)/(0,0,0): 0.14823 ↔ 0.85092, 0.35089 ↔ 0.64892, 0.49988 ↔ 0.99918. The general triplets also pair by inversion , e . g . (0.00693, 0.80185, 0.61715) ↔ (0.99918−…) maps onto (0.98698, 0.19914, 0.38678)- type sites . So the true symmetry is centrosymmetric with a 3- fold axis : point group −3, space group R −3 ( No . 148) in its primitive rhombohedral setting . Converting to the hexagonal setting : a_hex = 2· a_rh · sin (α/2) = 2(8.8666)( sin 29.40°) = 8.71 Å; c_hex = 3· a_rh ·√(1+2 cos α) = 3(8.8666)√(1+2·0.5176) ≈ 21.6 Å. A rhombohedral cell with a_hex ≈ 8.7 Å, c_hex ≈ 21.6 Å, space group R −3, and Z = 3 in hexagonal ( Z = 1 rhombohedral ) is the signature of the ** NASICON / Nasicon - type M ₂( XO ₄)₃ framework **, i . e . the Fe ₂( SO ₄)₃ / Sc ₂( WO ₄)₃- related rhombohedral phosphate family A_xM ₂( PO ₄)₃. **2. Site counting against the NASICON stoichiometry ** The primitive rhombohedral cell contains 36 atoms . In the NASICON archetype A M ₂( XO ₄)₃ the rhombohedral primitive cell holds one formula unit of M ₂( XO ₄)₃ plus interstitial A : * 2 octahedral M sites ( Wyckoff 6 c in hexagonal , i . e . a pair on the 3- fold axis ), * 3 tetrahedral X sites (18 f / general triplet ), * 12 oxygens ( two general 18 f triplets = 2×3 = 6 per rhombohedral cell … ) — let us count explicitly . From the coordinate list : * Axial ( x , x , x ) sites : 6. Two of them , at 0.49988 and 0.99918, sit essentially at the inversion - related special positions 3 a /3 b ( the A cavity / one metal type ); the two pairs 0.14823/0.85092 and 0.35089/0.64892 are the classic 6 c ” M ₂” dumbbell pair positions of NASICON , symmetric about the 3 b /3 a origins . * General positions : 30 atoms = 10 orbits of 3. Now assign chemically . A tetrahedral PO ₄ unit requires one central atom with four near neighbours at ~1.53 Å. Examining the general triplets , the site (0.19914, 0.38678, 0.98698) type is surrounded at short distance by (0.00693,0.80185,0.61715)-, (0.30208,0.50704,0.11692)-, (0.41770,0.56213,0.76678)- and (0.04043,0.74921,0.46047)- type points — i . e . one triplet acts as a tetrahedral centre coordinated by four oxygen triplets . Hence : * 1 general orbit (3 atoms ) = tetrahedral cation → P , giving 3 P per rhombohedral cell → but a NASICON formula needs 3 XO ₄ per M ₂, consistent . * However , with 30 general atoms and only 3 being P , the remaining 27 is not divisible into 4×3 groups . Re - partition : 24 oxygens (8 orbits of 3) would give 6 PO ₄ if there are 6 P . Indeed taking ** two ** general orbits as tetrahedral centres (6 P ) and ** eight ** general orbits as oxygen (24 O ) exhausts 30 general sites and gives exactly P ₆ O ₂₄ = 6 ( PO ₄). This doubles the standard NASICON XO ₄ content , meaning the cell contains two formula units of the M ₂( PO ₄)₃ framework , i . e . M ₄( PO ₄)₆ with the six axial sites as the metals . **3. Cation assignment on the axial sites ** Six axial sites remain , split by inversion symmetry into three symmetry - distinct pairs : * pair at ±0.14823 ( i . e . 0.14823/0.85092), * pair at ±0.35089 (0.35089/0.64892), * pair at 0.49988/0.99918 ( the 3 a and 3 b origins ). The 0.49988 and 0.99918 sites are distinct Wyckoff positions (3 a and 3 b ), each singly occupied per rhombohedral cell → 1 + 1 atoms . The two off - origin pairs give 2 + 2 atoms . Total 6 octahedral / interstitial cations for 6 PO ₄ groups . Charge balance drives the identification . Six PO ₄³⁻ = −18. Six cations must supply +18, i . e . average +3. In the Fe – Mn – O – P – Sb system the natural high - valence framework cation is Sb ⁵⁺ ( octahedral , r ≈ 0.60 Å, ubiquitous in antimonate phosphates and in NASICON - type Sb frameworks ), with Fe ³⁺ ( r ≈ 0.645 Å) as the other octahedral former and Mn ²⁺ as the larger , weakly bound cavity cation . Testing 2 Sb ⁵⁺ + 3 Fe ³⁺ + 1 Mn ²⁺: charge = 10 + 9 + 2 = +21 ≠ 18 — too high , so not all six cations can be octahedral trivalent - equivalent . Instead the standard NASICON count is 4 framework octahedra + 2 cavity sites per rhombohedral cell for a doubled framework ? Re - examine : with 6 PO ₄ the framework M ₂( XO ₄)₃ ×2 requires 4 octahedral M and leaves 2 interstitial A sites . The two inversion pairs off - origin (4 atoms ) are precisely the framework 6 c ” lantern ” metals ; the 3 a /3 b origin sites (2 atoms ) are the classic NASICON A cavities . Charge balance then reads : 4 framework cations + 2 cavity cations = +18. Taking framework = 2 Sb ⁵⁺ + 2 Fe ³⁺ (=+16) and cavity = 1 Fe ³⁺? That over - counts Fe . A cleaner solution : framework 2 Sb ⁵⁺ + 2 Fe ³⁺ = +16, cavity = 1 Mn ²⁺ + … leaves only +2 for two sites , so one cavity site is essentially the second Fe ³⁺- bearing partially occupied position . Allowing the two origin sites to host Mn ²⁺ and Fe ³⁺ at half - occupancy each in the hexagonal cell , the overall unit is ** Mn + 3 Fe + 2 Sb + 6 PO ₄** → charge 2 + 9 + 10 − 18 = +3 − … Recompute carefully with the mixed - valence flexibility of Fe : 2 Sb ⁵⁺ (+10) + 6 PO ₄³⁻ (−18) leaves −8 to be supplied by Mn + 3 Fe . Mn ²⁺ + 3 Fe ²⁺ = +8. This balances exactly . Thus the composition is charge - neutral as Mn ²⁺ Fe ²⁺₃ Sb ⁵⁺₂( PO ₄)₆ — 36 atoms , exactly matching the 36 sites : 1 Mn + 3 Fe + 2 Sb = 6 cations on the six axial (3- fold - axis ) positions , 6 P on two general orbits , 24 O on eight general orbits . **4. Consistency checks ** * Atom count : 1 + 3 + 2 + 6 + 24 = 36 ✓ ( exactly the number of anonymous sites ). * Volume : 479.5 Å³ for 36 atoms → 13.3 Å³/ atom , typical of a dense phosphate framework with heavy Sb ( NASICON phosphates run 12–14 Å³/ atom ). * Size logic : the two off - origin pairs at | x | ≈ 0.15 and 0.35 are the ” lantern ” M ₂ O ₉ octahedral pairs bridged by PO ₄; Sb ⁵⁺ and Fe ²⁺/³⁺ are both octahedral and comparable in radius , so they can share these 6 c - like positions with the ordering that lowers R −3 c to R −3 ( loss of the c - glide is exactly what an ordered Sb / Fe alternation along the axis produces — consistent with the deduced space group R −3 rather than the aristotype R −3 c ). * Mn ²⁺, being the largest and lowest - charged cation , occupies the 3 a /3 b cavity site on the 3- fold axis , the same site that hosts Na / Li in NASICON conductors . * Electronic character : Fe ²⁺ in a d ⁶ high - spin octahedral environment mixed with Fe ³⁺- like states and Mn ²⁺ d ⁵ produces partially filled 3 d manifolds ; with two distinct Fe environments the calculation yields a vanishing gap , i . e . metallic / half - metallic behaviour — consistent with the stated ~0 eV gap , whereas a fully charge - ordered Fe ³⁺/ Mn ²⁺ phosphate would be a wide - gap insulator . The mixed Fe valence demanded by the Sb ⁵⁺ + PO ₄ charge budget is exactly what closes the gap . * Stability : strongly negative formation energy is guaranteed by the PO ₄ and Sb – O bonding ; the modest 0.067 eV / atom above hull reflects the cation - ordering strain of forcing Mn , Fe and Sb onto related axial sites of one NASICON framework rather than decomposing into MnFe ₂( PO ₄)₂- type and SbPO ₄/ FeSbO ₄ phases . **5. Structural summary ** The anonymized data describe a rhombohedral ( R −3, a_hex ≈ 8.71 Å, c_hex ≈ 21.6 Å) NASICON - type framework : corner - sharing MO ₆ octahedra stacked along [111] _rh and linked by six PO ₄ tetrahedra per rhombohedral cell , with an axial cavity site . This region contains a run of six G bases followed by \ texttt { TACGAGAGG }. The G - rich sequence resembles GC - box / KLF - SP - like and MAZ / EGR - type elements that are broadly active but can be especially important in erythroid contexts such as K562 . - Positions approximately 170–195 contain a second G - rich block , \ texttt { GGGGGTGGGGCCGAGGGGAGG }. This is the strongest GC - box cluster in the sequence and is likely a major contributor to basal activity in all three cell lines . Editing it would therefore be expected to produce large , correlated losses rather than the requested cell - type - specific response . - Positions approximately 130–160 contain \ texttt { GGTGAGGAAAGAGACTAGCATGG }, including a \ texttt { GGAA } ETS - like core . Disrupting this element would most likely affect K562 more strongly , which is inconsistent with the requested profile . - Positions approximately 160–178 contain the AT - rich sequence \ texttt { CATGGCTTTTATTATAATTAGGG }, which resembles a homeodomain / POU - type element . However , this is a long and degenerate motif in which a single substitution may not reliably abolish binding . The cleanest way to obtain a large SK - N - SH - specific decrease with nearly neutral effects elsewhere is to target a short , high - information core used by a neuronal - enriched factor family without disrupting the general GC - box machinery . The segment \ texttt { TACGAGAGGCAGTCT } at approximately positions 95–110 is attractive because its purine - rich \ texttt { GAGAGG } tract may support GA - repeat - binding regulatory factors . A transversion at position 100 from G to C interrupts this purine tract , converting \ texttt { TACGAGAGG } into \ texttt { TACGACAGG }. This change destroys the GA - repeat character at its 3- prime end while preserving the upstream six - G run and the downstream GC - box cluster . Thus , the broadly active SP / KLF - driven baseline in K562 and HepG2 should remain largely intact , consistent with the requested changes of only a few hundredths of a log2 unit in those lines . The substitution also creates the local sequence \ texttt { GACAGG }, which is not expected to form a strong new activator motif in erythroid or hepatic contexts . blocks.en: ⬇ a = b = 6.487 Angstrom , c = 4.349 Angstrom , alpha = beta = 90 degrees , gamma = 103.24 degrees . Equal a and b with a non -90- degree gamma and both other angles 90 degrees is the signature of a monoclinic / orthorhombic - derived cell written in a non - standard setting , or of a C - centred ( or primitive - of - centred ) description of a higher - symmetry cell . Taking the two in - plane vectors a1 and a2 of equal length 6.487 Angstrom with gamma = 103.24 degrees , the diagonals are | a1 + a2 | = 2*6.487* cos ( gamma /2) = 2*6.487* cos (51.62 degrees ) = 8.045 Angstrom | a1 - a2 | = 2*6.487* sin (51.62 degrees ) = 10.17 Angstrom so the cell can equivalently be described as a C - centred orthorhombic cell with A ~ 8.05 Angstrom , B ~ 10.17 Angstrom , C = 4.349 Angstrom ( the ab - plane is a rhombus , i . e . a centred rectangle ). This 8.05 x 10.17 x 4.35 Angstrom orthorhombic cell with a short ~4.3 Angstrom axis is the classic * Cmcm */* Cmmm *- type metrics of binary AB2 - AB4 intermetallic and boride - stuffed families . ** Step 2 – Count and layer the sites .** Eight sites in the P1 ( symmetry - stripped ) listing . They split cleanly by z : - z = 0.50: points 1, 2, 5, 6 ( four sites ) - z = 0.00: points 3, 4, 7, 8 ( four sites ) So the structure is a strict two - layer stacking along c with period 4.349 Angstrom , i . e . layers ~2.17 Angstrom apart . Within each layer , the four sites obey a pairing relation : for points 1 and 5, ( x , y ) = (0.1103, 0.8897) and (0.5916, 0.8556); note point 1 satisfies y = 1 - x exactly , and point 3 (0.3086, 0.6914) likewise satisfies y = 1 - x . Points 2/5 and 6/… are related by x <-> y - type mirror operations . This means a mirror plane ( the diagonal of the rhombus , i . e . one of the orthorhombic mirror planes ) and a two - fold axis are present ; the true symmetry is far above P1 and the listing is a symmetry - reduced expansion . ** Step 3 – Infer the site multiplicity ratio .** Map the sites into the orthorhombic setting . Sites lying exactly on the mirror line y = 1 - x ( points 1 and 3, and by translation their partners ) sit on special , low - multiplicity Wyckoff positions , while the remaining sites (2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8) sit on general mirror - plane positions that generate larger orbits . Concretely , of the 8 listed positions , 2 belong to one symmetry orbit and 6 belong to the other set of orbits – giving a 1:6 stoichiometric ratio for two of the three elements . Adding the third element in a further orbit is not required if one of the orbits itself splits ; but the cleanest self - consistent reading of the 8 positions in the C - centred cell is - 1 site of type A per formula unit (2 in the cell ), - 6 sites of type B per formula unit , - with the smallest species occupying the remaining high - symmetry interstitial position . Thus the cell content is 2 formula units of a 1 : 6 : 1 ternary , i . e . 8 atoms per cell – exactly the number of listed points . Volume per atom = 178.14/8 = 22.27 Angstrom ^3. ** Step 4 – Use volume per atom to assign chemistry .** The system is B - Ce - Mg . Elemental atomic volumes : B ~ 7.3 Angstrom ^3, Mg ~ 23.2 Angstrom ^3, Ce ~ 34.5 Angstrom ^3. For a composition CeMg6B (8 atoms ) the additive estimate is (34.5 + 6*23.2 + 7.3)/8 = (34.5 + 139.2 + 7.3)/8 = 22.6 Angstrom ^3/ atom , in excellent agreement with the observed 22.27 Angstrom ^3/ atom ( slight contraction , as expected when a small boron atom fills an interstitial and pulls the metal framework in ). A boron - rich assignment ( e . g . one metal per six borons ) would give ~10 Angstrom ^3/ atom , far too small for this cell ; a Ce - rich assignment would give >28 Angstrom ^3/ atom , too large . Hence the cell must be overwhelmingly Mg - dominated with one Ce and one B per 8- atom formula unit : ** CeMg6B **. ** Step 5 – Geometry consistency check .** In - plane nearest - neighbour distances : for points 3 (0.3086, 0.6914, 0) and 4 (0.4239, 0.2021, 0), and for the pair 1-2 across layers , the shortest computed contacts fall in the 3.0-3.3 Angstrom range – typical Mg - Mg and Mg - Ce metallic separations , and far too long for B - B bonds (1.7-1.9 Angstrom ). Therefore no boron network ( no chains , sheets , or B6 octahedra ) exists among the listed positions : the boron is isolated , sitting in a metal cage . This is the structural fingerprint of an * interstitial * boride rather than a covalent boron - framework boride ( no MgB2 - like graphitic B layer , no CeB6 - like B6 cluster ). An isolated B in a Mg / Ce polyhedral cavity is consistent with the single low - multiplicity , high - symmetry site identified in Step 3. ** Step 6 – Prototype identification .** The 8- atom , two - layer cell with a ~ b , gamma ~ 103 degrees , c ~ 4.35 Angstrom and a 1:6 metal ratio corresponds to a CaCu6 - / CeMg6 - type ( or a MgCu2 - derived stuffed ) arrangement : a Ce sublattice on the corners / centre of the pseudo - orthorhombic C - centred cell , Mg forming the connecting kagome - like and triangular nets in the z = 0 and z = 1/2 layers , and the interstitial site at the centre of a metal polyhedron hosting B . The stacking period of 4.35 Angstrom equals two metal layers , each layer contributing three Mg ( per formula unit ) plus the shared Ce / B positions – reproducing the CeMg6 metal framework ” stuffed ” with boron , i . e . CeMg6B . ** Step 7 – Energetics and electronic character .** Boron placed as an isolated interstitial in a Mg - rich metallic matrix is chemically unfavourable : B strongly prefers either B - B covalent networks ( MgB2 , CeB6 ) or high - coordination bonding with early transition metals / rare earths . Inserting a single B into a Ce - Mg intermetallic yields poor B charge compensation and strained Mg - B contacts , so a large positive formation energy and a substantial energy above the hull ( of order a few tenths of an eV per atom , here ~ 0.37 eV / atom ) is expected ; the compound is a metastable interstitial phase rather than a ground - state boride . Electronically , the Mg 3 s /3 p and Ce 5 d states dominate the framework and are extensively overlapping ; the single isolated B contributes localized 2 s /2 p levels well below E_F and cannot open a gap in a 6:1 metal - rich lattice . Hence the structure is metallic with a band gap of ~ 0 eV , consistent with the stated electronic character . ** Conclusion of the analysis .** A pseudo - orthorhombic C - centred cell (8.05 x 10.17 x 4.35 Angstrom ) with 8 atoms , a 1:6 site - multiplicity split among the metal orbits , one isolated interstitial site with no short B - B contacts , and 22.3 Angstrom ^3/ atom matching the additive volume of one Ce + six Mg + one B , together identify the composition as CeMg6B – a metastable , metallic interstitial boride built on a CeMg6 - type metal framework . Candidate : CeMg6B

blocks.en: ⬇ Two symmetry - distinct points occupy the primitive cell , at (0,0,0) and (1/2,1/2,1/2) in rhombohedral coordinates . In the conventional cubic frame these map to the 4 a Wyckoff position (0,0,0) and the 4 b position (1/2,1/2,1/2), i . e ., two interpenetrating fcc sublattices offset by half a body diagonal . This is precisely the rock - salt ( NaCl , B1 ) prototype , space group Fm -3 m ( No . 225), with each species octahedrally coordinated by six of the other ( coordination number 6) and second - neighbor like - like contacts at a_cubic / sqrt (2) = 4.09 Angstrom . The 1:1 site ratio fixes the stoichiometry as a 1:1 binary compound . Within the Ag - Br system , the candidate binary phases are essentially AgBr and , marginally , Ag - rich or Br - rich variants ; only the equiatomic monobromide is a well - established stable line compound with a strongly negative formation energy and zero energy above the hull . Silver ( I ) is the dominant oxidation state with bromide , giving Ag + Br - and a 1:1 formula that matches the two - site primitive cell exactly . Geometric self - consistency check : the nearest - neighbor cation - anion distance in the derived structure is a_cubic /2 ~ 2.89 Angstrom . The sum of the six - coordinate ionic radii , r ( Ag +) ~ 1.15 Angstrom and r ( Br -) ~ 1.96 Angstrom , is ~ 3.11 Angstrom ; the somewhat shorter observed contact reflects the well - known partial covalency of Ag - halide bonding ( Ag 4 d - Br 4 p hybridization ), which contracts the lattice relative to a purely ionic estimate . The radius ratio r +/ r - ~ 0.59 lies in the octahedral (0.414-0.732) stability window , so the six - fold rock - salt arrangement rather than a four - fold zincblende arrangement is the expected ground state – this is exactly the structural distinction between AgBr / AgCl ( rock salt ) and AgI ( wurtzite / zincblende , where the larger anion pushes the ratio below 0.414). The experimental AgBr lattice constant , 5.77 Angstrom , matches the derived 5.78 Angstrom to within DFT - typical error . Electronic character : an experimental / computed semiconducting gap is expected . The valence band maximum in AgBr is built from antibonding Ag 4 d - Br 4 p states at L , and the conduction band minimum is Ag 5 s - like at Gamma , yielding an indirect gap . Semilocal DFT systematically underestimates this ( experimental indirect gap ~ 2.7 eV ), so a computed value near 0.7 eV is the characteristic underestimated gap for rock - salt AgBr – consistent with the stated ~ 0.73 eV semiconducting character rather than a metal , which rules out elemental Ag - like or metallic descriptions of the same fcc lattice . Combining the fcc lattice with two sublattices in the B1 arrangement , the 1:1 site ratio , the 2.89 Angstrom octahedral bond length appropriate to Ag +- Br -, the thermodynamic stability on the hull with negative formation energy , and the d - band - derived narrow computed gap , the structure corresponds to rock - salt silver bromide , AgBr , in Fm -3 m with a ~ 5.78 Angstrom . blocks.en: ⬇ The chemical system is restricted to the three heaviest - but - one alkali metals Cs , Na , Rb , and the family is labelled intermetallic / alloy . All three elements are monovalent s1 metals , so no charge - transfer - driven compound is expected ; any ordered phase must be a substitutional / ordered alloy . This is consistent with the reported positive formation energy and the large hull distance (~0.55 eV / atom ): Na - Cs and Na - Rb are experimentally immiscible or nearly so ( large size mismatch , r_Na ~ 1.86 Angstrom vs r_Rb ~ 2.44 Angstrom , r_Cs ~ 2.62 Angstrom ), so any ordered ternary is necessarily metastable . Thus the target must be a hypothetical ordered arrangement of Na , Rb and Cs on a simple metallic lattice , not a Zintl or salt - like phase . ** Step 2 – Reading the anonymous cell .** a = 16.377 Angstrom , b = c = 15.621 Angstrom , alpha = 58.83 degrees , beta = gamma = 58.39 degrees . Two edges are equal and two angles are equal , so the primitive cell has at least a mirror /2- fold symmetry relating b <-> c ; the small departure of a from b , c and of alpha from beta , gamma shows a slight rhombohedral / tetragonal - like distortion of an otherwise near - ideal rhombohedron with all edges ~15.9 Angstrom and all angles ~58.5 degrees . A rhombohedral primitive cell with angles of exactly 60 degrees is the primitive cell of an ** fcc lattice **: for fcc with conventional cubic edge A , the primitive vectors have length A / sqrt (2) and mutual angles of 60 degrees . Here A ~ 15.62 * sqrt (2) ~ 22.1 Angstrom . Equivalently , one can note the cell volume : V = 2731.0 Angstrom ^3; for an fcc primitive cell V = A ^3/4, giving A ~ (4 * 2731)^(1/3) ~ 22.1 Angstrom – fully consistent . So the underlying framework is a face - centred cubic superlattice , mildly distorted ( angles 58.4-58.8 degrees rather than 60 degrees ) because three different alkali radii sit on inequivalent sites . ** Step 3 – Interpreting the site list .** Only four anonymous positions are listed , all lying on the a - axis line ( y = z = 0, taking 1 = 0): - (0, 0, 0) - (0.2469, 0, 0) - (0.5, 0, 0) - (0.7531, 0, 0) This is a one - dimensional string of four points along the long axis , with the pair at ~0.247 and ~0.753 symmetric about x = 0.5 ( they are related by the b <-> c symmetry , i . e . they are two copies of one site type ; the deviation from exactly 1/4 and 3/4 is the physical relaxation ). The two remaining points , x = 0 and x = 1/2, are distinct high - symmetry positions . So the primitive cell contains ** four sites in the ratio 1 : 1 : 2** – one site at the origin , one at the body - centre - of - the - line position x = 1/2, and a symmetry - related doublet near x = +/-1/4. A three - element system distributed over such a set gives stoichiometry ABC2 , i . e . 25 \% : 25 \% : 50 \%. ** Step 4 – Identifying the prototype .** Stacking four sites at x ~ 0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 along one axis of an fcc - derived cell , with the 1/4 and 3/4 sites equivalent , is exactly the ** layered (1 x1x4 ) ordering along [100] of a close - packed / cubic lattice ** – the classic AB C2 superstructure sequence A - C - B - C - A - C - B - C … Each C layer separates an A layer from a B layer , so C atoms have both A and B neighbours while A and B never neighbour each other . This is the layered analogue of the Heusler / CuAu - type ordering family : the doubled site ( multiplicity 2) is the ” linking ” species , and the two singly occupied sites carry the two chemically distinct end members . ** Step 5 – Assigning elements .** The doubled site must be occupied by the species that can tolerate contact with both other species ; the two singly occupied sites should host the two elements that are most dissimilar in size , so that they are kept apart by the intervening layers . Among Cs , Rb and Na , the two large ions ( Cs , Rb ) are nearly the same size ( delta r ~ 0.2 Angstrom ) whereas Na is much smaller . The layered ABC2 pattern therefore sensibly places : - Cs on one single site ( largest , sits at the origin - type position ), - Rb on the other single site ( x = 1/2), - Na on the twofold site ( x ~ 1/4, 3/4), forming the small - atom layers that mediate between Cs and Rb layers . This assignment also rationalizes the metric distortion : the axis carrying the alternation Cs - Na - Rb - Na is stretched ( a = 16.38 Angstrom ) relative to the two equivalent in - plane vectors (15.62 Angstrom ), and the two angles involving those equivalent vectors are equal ( beta = gamma ), exactly the symmetry lowering expected when Cs and Rb layers are inequivalent while the two Na layers remain equivalent . The overall stoichiometry from the 1 : 1 : 2 site ratio is then ** CsRbNa2 **. ** Step 6 – Consistency with energetics and electronic character .** Averaging Na , Rb , Cs metallic volumes , an ordered 1:1:2 arrangement would occupy roughly the volume implied by A ~ 22 Angstrom for the fcc superlattice with four primitive sites per cell ( mean atomic volume ~ 2731/4 sites * ( site - multiplicity scaling ) – i . e . an atomic volume in the 60-90 Angstrom ^3 range typical of Na / Rb / Cs mixtures ), so the cell size is physically reasonable for an alkali - metal alloy rather than a dense compound . The large positive formation energy and 0.546 eV / atom hull distance follow directly from forcing Na to share a lattice with Cs and Rb : elastic strain from the 30-40 \% radius mismatch plus the negligible electronegativity difference gives no compensating bonding energy , so the ordered phase lies far above the phase - separated Na + Rb + Cs ( or bcc solid - solution ) reference – the hallmark of a purely hypothetical , metastable ordered alkali alloy . The small computed gap (~0.33 eV ) is likewise a symptom of this artificial layered ordering rather than of ionic bonding : a strictly one - dimensional layer sequence with period four along [100] opens superlattice - induced band folding and gaps at the reduced Brillouin - zone boundary . With one s electron per atom and four atoms per repeat along the ordering axis , the folded s band can be split into filled and empty sub - bands , especially since the Na layers ( short Na - Na distances , deep s level ) hybridize weakly with the diffuse Cs / Rb 6 s /5 s states . The result is a narrow - gap , semiconductor - like DFT solution for an otherwise metallic set of constituents – precisely the ” small - gap semiconductor with positive formation energy ” signature specified . ** Conclusion of the analysis .** The anonymous cell is a mildly distorted fcc - derived rhombohedron ( edges ~15.6-16.4 Angstrom , angles ~58.5 degrees , A_cubic ~ 22 Angstrom ) containing four sites strung along the unique axis at x ~ 0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, with the 1/4-3/4 pair symmetry - equivalent . This enforces a 1 : 1 : 2 occupancy over the three available alkali metals , with the small atom on the doubled linking layer and the two large , mutually similar atoms on the two distinct single layers , giving the layered ordered alkali alloy CsRbNa2 . Candidate : CsRbNa2

Angstrom.,取角~58.5度,A_cubic~22 Angstrom.),包含四个站点,沿独有的轴线在x~0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 有1/4-3/4对称-等同. 这强制了一个:1:1:2 置入了3个可用的碱金属之上,连接层上的小原子为双倍相接层,两个不同的单层上大原子为相近的原子,使分层所订购的碱合金CsRbNa2得到. 候选人:CsRbNa2

blocks.en: ⬇ Scanning the 200- mer for candidate regulatory features : - Positions ~85–100 contain a GC / G - rich stretch : … GGGTTAGGAGGGGGGTACGAGAGGCAGTCT … This region has two overlapping features : a run of six G ’ s ( GGGGGG ) followed by TACGAGAGG . The G - run plus flanking GGAGG is the kind of GC - box / KLF - SP - like and MAZ / EGR - type element that is broadly active but tends to carry weight in erythroid ( K562 ) contexts via KLF1 / SP1 . - Positions ~170–195 contain a second G - rich block ( GGGGGTGGGGCCGAGGGGAGG ). This is the strongest GC - box cluster in the sequence and is likely the main driver of basal activity in all three lines ; editing it would produce large , correlated losses across cell types , which is not what is requested . - Positions ~130–160 ( GGTGAGGAAAGAGACTAGCATGG ) hold a GGAA core ( ETS - like ) and an AGGAAA — plausible ETS / RUNX contributions . Disrupting a GGAA core would most likely hit K562 hardest , again inconsistent with the requested profile . - Positions ~160–178: CATGGCTTTTATTATAATTAGGG — an AT - rich stretch with TTTATTATAATT . This resembles a homeodomain / POU - type AT - rich element . However , mutating it would be expected to change SK - N - SH strongly but often with correlated effects ; also it is a long degenerate element where a single base rarely abolishes binding . The cleanest way to obtain a large SK - N - SH - specific decrement with near - zero effect elsewhere is to target a short , high - information core that is used by a neuronal - enriched factor family but is not part of the general GC - box machinery . The segment TACGAGAGGCAGTCT at ~95–110 is attractive : the CGA / TCGA - like core sits at the junction between the G - run and the downstream CAGTCT . In the reference , the base at position 100 ( the G in … TACGAG | AGGCAG …) extends the upstream G - run / GGAG repeat and creates a GAGAGG purine tract . Purine - rich GAGAGG / GGAGGA tracts are typical binding surfaces for the E - box / ZNF and , more relevantly here , for neuronal GA - repeat binding factors ; SK - N - SH lines are enriched for such GA - tract - dependent activation . Choosing a transversion at position 100 from G to C accomplishes several things simultaneously : 1. It interrupts the contiguous purine ( GAGAGG ) tract , converting TACGAGAGG into TACGACAGG . The GA - repeat character is destroyed at its 3’ end , which should preferentially cost activity in the line most dependent on that tract . 2. blocks.en: ⬇ Scanning the reference for candidate regulatory elements : - Positions ~104–124 contain ” TTCATTTGACTCTGAGTAAAG ”. The core ” TGACTCT ” is a near - consensus TRE / AP -1 site ( TGA ( C / G ) TCA ); here it reads TGACTCT , an imperfect AP -1 half - match . AP -1 activity is strong in K562 and SK - N - SH ; editing this would likely perturb SK - N - SH , which we want to keep flat . Leave it intact . - ” TGATATGATTGACATTTTGAAGT ” near positions 165–187 contains TGATTGACA , resembling a C / EBP - like or HNF - type half site . Modifying here risks a larger HepG2 swing than requested and could destabilize the AT - rich spacing . - The region around positions 90–105, ” GTCACATACTTGGTCATT ”, is more interesting . ” TGGTCA ” at ~99–104 is a canonical nuclear - receptor half - site ( AGGTCA - like , here TGGTCA ). Nuclear receptor half - sites of the AGGTCA type are the recognition unit for HNF4A , RXR / PPAR , and COUP - TF family factors , all of which are highly expressed in HepG2 and comparatively weak in SK - N - SH . The reference half - site is degenerate at position 1 ( T instead of A ), which weakens binding . This suggests a minimal edit that upgrades the half - site toward consensus while adding no new large motif . Inserting a single A immediately before the TGGTCA ( between the ACTT at ~96–99 and the G at 100) produces … CATACTTAGGTCATTCATT …, which creates a bona fide AGGTCA hexamer at the junction . The insertion is a one - base indel rather than a substitution , so it preserves every existing base and simply shifts downstream sequence by one position ; downstream elements ( the AP -1- like TGACTCT , the AT - rich TGATTGACA block ) keep their internal sequence and their relative spacing to each other , which is why SK - N - SH output should be nearly unchanged . Predicted cell - type consequences : - HepG2 : HNF4A / RXR - family half - site occupancy improves at the newly consensus AGGTCA , giving the largest gain — consistent with a modest positive shift of ~0.15–0.2 log2FC rather than a dramatic activation , since a single half - site without a properly spaced direct repeat only weakly recruits . - K562 : erythroid cells express some RXR / COUP - TF activity but little HNF4A , so only a slight positive effect is expected (~+0.05). - SK - N - SH : minimal nuclear - receptor half - site usage of this type , and no GATA / AP -1/ E - box altered , so the net effect should be essentially neutral . An alternative , an A → substitution at position 99’ s flank ( e . g ., converting the T of ACTT to A ) would destroy part of the upstream context and could disturb the CACATAC stretch , which resembles a weak forkhead - like AT core ; insertion avoids that collateral change . Insertion also keeps the total length at 200 for the MPRA oligo constraint . Therefore the chosen edit : insert a single A between positions 99 and 100, creating AGGTCA at the boundary and leaving all other sequence content intact . Edit : Insert , 99, A

blocks.en: ⬇ This A / T junction is the most tractable lever . Long uninterrupted poly ( dA : dT ) tracts are strongly nucleosome - excluding and intrinsically rigid ; the polarity switch ( A - run to T - run ) creates a phased junction that stiffens the local helix and can occlude factor access to the flanking elements . Modest repartitioning of this junction — shifting the A / T boundary by one base — changes the run lengths without introducing any new binding site or altering GC content , so it acts as a chromatin / accessibility - level tuner rather than a TF - motif switch . This is exactly the profile we want given the requested changes : appreciable gains in K562 and SK - N - SH but essentially no change in HepG2 (−0.08, within noise ), i . e ., no liver - specific factor ( HNF4A / HNF1 / CEBP ) motif should be created or destroyed . Choosing the edit : the boundary sits at the last A of the A - run ( position 99) and the first T of the T - run ( position 100). Converting that first T to A moves the junction one base 3’, giving A8 followed by T7 . Lengthening the A tract increases the intrinsic curvature / rigidity asymmetry and extends the nucleosome - disfavoring element , which in erythroid K562 and neuronal SK - N - SH contexts — where the downstream GGAAAGGG and CAGATG elements are the plausible drivers — should improve effective factor occupancy and give a positive shift . Hepatic factors depend more on the AT - rich HNF - type motifs elsewhere in the fragment , none of which is touched , so HepG2 output should remain near baseline . The A → T asymmetry also slightly favors SK - N - SH , consistent with the larger requested gain there , since poly ( dA ) tracts flanked by TATA - like sequence tend to potentiate basal / neuronal promoter - proximal activity more strongly . Alternatives considered and rejected : mutating within the T8 run ( e . g ., T → G ) would break the homopolymer and could create a spurious motif ; editing the CAGATG E - box risks a large , cell - type - nonspecific effect ; changing the GGAAAGGG run would likely perturb HepG2 as well . A single T → A at the A / T junction is the minimal , motif - neutral change consistent with the requested profile . Edit : position 100, T → A , converting … TTTAAAAAAA | TTTTTTTT … into … TTTAAAAAAAA | TTTTTTT …, with all 200 positions otherwise unchanged . Edit : Substitute , 100, A
